name: Nested PCA-Reduced Patient-Mean Logistic Fusion
summary: This simple reference plan tests whether mean-pooled H&E features improve four-class PAM50 prediction over the six clinical covariates. Within repeated patient-level nested cross-validation, each fold fits identical missing-level clinical encodings, reduces one inner-selected encoder via PCA, and trains class-balanced logistic regression paired with a tuned clinical-only model. A site-held-out analysis checks site confounding. The paired bootstrap 95% interval for macro-F1 difference determines whether global morphology improves, worsens, or shows insufficient evidence.
preprocessing: Verify patient-level alignment across all 802 labelled patients (keeping multi-slide patients pooled into their single patient-mean vector per encoder), exclude the 259 unlabelled patients from supervised splits, and exclude all RNA-derived variables and collection site from predictor matrices.

Inside each inner, outer, and site-held-out training fold, impute age with the training-fold median and z-score standardise it; one-hot encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 using training-fold categories plus an explicit 'Missing' category level, sharing the exact encoded clinical matrix between clinical_only and patient_mean_logreg.

Inside each training fold, z-score standardise the candidate encoder's patient-mean H&E vector using training-fold mean and SD, fit PCA strictly on training-fold patients to retain n_pca components, z-score standardise the resulting PC scores using training-fold SDs, and concatenate with the clinical features.
Run sanity checks before scoring confirming disjoint patient IDs across splits, identical patient ordering across both arms, and non-trivial behaviour of the tuned clinical_only comparator.

training.convergence_check: Record per-iteration multinomial cross-entropy loss and gradient norm in every fold; confirm optimisation converges prior to max_epochs with trailing relative loss change below 1e-5.

tuning.tie_rule: Treat inner-fold macro-F1 differences smaller than 0.005 as ties and select the most parsimonious configuration (smaller n_pca, smaller C).

validation.oof_aggregation: Evaluate paired out-of-fold predictions on identical splits across the 3 repeats, compute repeat-averaged patient-level class probabilities for the 802 patients, and draw 10,000 patient-level bootstrap resamples with replacement to form the paired 95% confidence interval.
validation.site_sensitivity: Run grouped leave-one-site-out cross-validation across all 19 collection sites (using site strictly as split group, never as a feature) with 3-fold patient-level inner CV inside training sites for both clinical_only and patient_mean_logreg.

metrics: Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only) across repeated nested CV with a patient-level 95% bootstrap confidence interval
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only)
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only)
Per-class recall differences for LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2
Site-held-out paired macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus clinical-only) across the 19 collection sites
allowed_conclusions: Conclude 'improves' if the 95% patient-level bootstrap confidence interval for paired macro-F1 difference lies strictly above zero, 'worse' if strictly below zero, and 'insufficient evidence' if it contains zero; qualify potential site confounding using the 19-site held-out difference and restrict scope to incremental linear patient-mean H&E prediction in this TCGA-BRCA cohort.

diversity.method: early concatenation with nested encoder/PCA grid selection

rationale: Foundation embeddings risk overfitting on 802 imbalanced patients alongside informative receptor covariates. Fold-internal PCA with class-balanced L2 logistic regression provides a low-variance linear benchmark under nested encoder selection. Complex tile-level or non-linear models are justified only if they outperform this reference on identical folds.
